calculation.description: Negative prior-session asset return, amplified when observation-only VIX is unusually stressed. Robust VIX stress is the log VIX deviation from its 60-session rolling median divided by a rolling 60-session median absolute deviation, clipped to [-3,3]. Signal uses only data available through the prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (+0.055374), 2023-2024 (+0.031892), and 2025-2027 (+0.033324). Small 15-instrument cross-section warrants conservative interpretation.
